description: This is a Java test class for the QuickKeyHistoryRecords component in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of the history record management, including loading, storing, limiting size, handling incognito mode, and equality of history keys.

classes.name: QuickKeyHistoryRecordsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the QuickKeyHistoryRecords functionality, including loading, storing, size limits, incognito mode handling, and key equality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by obtaining shared preferences.

methods.name: testLoadHasDefaultValue
methods.description: Verifies that the default history contains the default emoji.

methods.name: testEmptyHistory
methods.description: Tests behavior when the history is set to a specific string and then cleared.

methods.name: testLoad
methods.description: Checks that loading a specific history string results in the correct list of history keys.

methods.name: testStoreAndLoadFromPrefs
methods.description: Verifies storing a new key-value pair and loading it back correctly.

methods.name: testLoadMoreThanLimit
methods.description: Ensures that loading a history string exceeding the maximum size trims the list appropriately.

methods.name: testStore
methods.description: Tests storing multiple keys and verifying the history list updates correctly.

methods.name: testDoesNotLoadIfEmptyStrings
methods.description: Checks that empty strings in the history string are ignored during load.

methods.name: testStoreDuplicateKey
methods.description: Verifies that storing a duplicate key updates the existing entry.

methods.name: testStoreMoreThanLimit
methods.description: Ensures that storing more than the maximum size trims the oldest entries.

methods.name: testDoesNotStoreInIncognitoMode
methods.description: Verifies that storing in incognito mode does not affect the history.

methods.name: testHistoryKeyEqualsOnlyName
methods.description: Checks that the equality of HistoryKey objects depends only on the name.
